This is a connection check from your PC.
It doesn’t measure in-game ping or battle performance.
Other players may get different results.
Running a check
10 samples per channel is the default. Choose 20, 40, 60 or 120 to observe changes over a longer period.
Pause large downloads, game updates and cloud backups. Other devices sharing your connection can also affect the scan.
Reading the results
• Connection time: Time taken to establish a TCP connection.
• Reply wait: Additional time after connecting until the channel’s four-byte opening message has been read.
• Total time: Connection time and Reply wait combined.
In Connection / Reply view, Connection time is teal and Reply wait is dashed blue. Switching views does not change the suggestion.
Observed ranges summarize individual successful measurements across all channels. The charts share a zero-based scale that adjusts to the results; the observed range is separate from that scale.
39/40 means 39 successful checks out of 40 attempted so far, excluding warm-up. Failed checks could not connect or read the complete opening message; they are not a packet-loss measurement.

Jitter shows how much Total time changes between checks. It averages the size of changes between adjacent successful checks; failed checks break the sequence. Lower values mean steadier check timings.
Hover over or focus a channel for measurements and saved history. Press Enter or Space, or choose View in Details, for the endpoint and full timestamps. Escape closes the panel.
Choosing a channel

Suggested channel favours successful checks, then balances Total time and Jitter. Several channels look similar means the pick has close alternatives. Not enough data means there are too few comparable successful checks to suggest a channel.
Fastest connection compares average Connection time. Most consistent compares Jitter.
Saved history
Completed scans are saved on this PC by default, including failed checks; cancelled scans are not saved. History is not uploaded and never changes the current suggestion.

In Settings, keep scans for 7, 30 or 90 days, or choose no age limit. Set a storage limit of 100, 250 or 500 MiB, or turn off saving. Comparisons use up to seven days of compatible scans. Timing summaries weight each scan equally; the plot shows separate scans, not continuous monitoring.
Clear saved history deletes saved scans, keeping exported reports and current results.

Optional checks of Nexon's official Mabinogi notices record confirmed game-maintenance completion dates. Recorded maintenance dates can shorten comparisons. If dates are unavailable or out of date, saved dates and the seven-day limit still apply.
